package.load.schema.assembly_tools.when: validator issue schema_path is AgentAssemblySpec.tools[] or Pydantic error mentions tools.N model_type
package.load.schema.assembly_tools.rule: Repair the package tool through authoring so manifest, package index, dependencies, assembly tools, and tool access stay aligned.

package.load.schema.node_binding.when: validator issue schema_path is AgentAssemblySpec.bindings.node_bindings[] or Pydantic error mentions bindings.node_bindings.N missing target/payload
package.load.schema.node_binding.rule: For built-in patterns, regenerate coherent bindings through authoring instead of hand-writing node_bindings.

extra_forbidden.node_id_provider_id.when: validator issue reports extra_forbidden for node_id, impl, provider_id, or similar fields inside a binding item
extra_forbidden.node_id_provider_id.rule: Do not keep provider_id or node_id as top-level binding fields. For built-in patterns, regenerate bindings through authoring.
